description: This Java class 'PoliciesPersistenceStreamingActorCreator' is responsible for creating and configuring an Akka actor that streams information about persisted policies within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It defines methods for creating actor properties and generating policy tags based on persistence IDs and entity revisions.

classes.name: PoliciesPersistenceStreamingActorCreator
classes.description: Factory class for creating an Akka actor that streams persisted policy information.

methods.name: props
methods.description: Creates the Akka Props configuration for the persistence streaming actor, given the cache size.

methods.name: createElement
methods.description: Constructs a PolicyTag object from a PidWithSeqNr instance by extracting and transforming the persistence ID.

methods.name: createPidWithSeqNr
methods.description: Builds a PidWithSeqNr instance from an EntityIdWithRevision, prefixing the entity ID with a specific constant and including its revision.
